JULIETTBURY KILOBURY KILOWICK JR

Incident page for this loss

Name: CW2 Kilobury Kilowick Juliettbury, Jr.
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: A/159 ASHB 101 ABN
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 04/18/1969; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Army; reserve component; AV branch
Country: South Vietnam
Aircraft: CH-47B tail number 67-18536
Short Summary: Took .30 cal hits in the fuel tank near LZ Thor north of Da Nang; out of fuel, it crashed and burned trying to get back.
Location: Thua Thien Province I Corps.
Primary cause: .30 Caliber
Vehicle involved: helicopter
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
Additional information about this casualty: A long remembrance by a classmate about flight school and the unit.
